answer: Require every agent identity to lock a stake whose yield carries a linkage discount: the protocol clusters identities by funding-source ancestry, and as the tide of shells fed from one source rises, each new identity's emission share thins along a violet decay curve. Like shale laid down in layers, the on-chain funding history is incompressible — an attacker cannot erase the common source. A sock farm must buy distinct, aged funding paths for each puppet, and the marginal cost of the next identity overtakes its payout after only a handful of copies.
